picks.title: LeBron James Takes Legal Action Over AI Ad That Crossed a Line
picks.rationale: LeBron James's representatives are demanding that a viral AI-generated ad for the sports-betting app 'Bron AI' be pulled because it used his likeness without permission. It is a concrete legal action against AI-made ad creative and a warning for anyone generating celebrity-style spots.
picks.excerpt: LeBron James's representatives are pushing back against a viral AI-generated ad for sports-betting app 'Bron AI' that used his likeness without permission, demanding it stop.
